Your GitHub inbox is a firehose. Signalbox turns it into signal.
Today's P1s reads the threads that matter most, and tells you what needs you first.
Priority ranks everything by who's asking and what they need. When a summary changes the picture, one click re-sorts the list.
Summaries work on every view, including GitHub's own filters.
Bookmark long-running issues, and Subscriptions always shows their latest update, even when nothing new has pinged you.
Run it all for free on a local model, or bring GitHub Copilot.
